messages:
Zoe (Support): Sparkline Labs flagged a duplicate charge on invoice INV-2026-0099 — they say two line items for the same endpoint usage. Customer provided screenshots. https://console.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0099

Zoe (Support): They say the duplicate appears after the price experiment last week (multiplier applied twice). Customer is asking for refund + explanation.

Elena (Sales): Sparkline is on a beta pricing experiment (mult:1.25) that ran 2026-05-10 -> 2026-05-12. We rolled back but there was a rollout overlap. Sales has a signed beta agreement.

Omar (BillingOps): Pulling invoice details... INV-2026-0099 total: $12,640. Line items show: endpoint-prod: $5,200, endpoint-prod (duplicate): $5,200, mini-support fee: $2,240. Promo/credits: $0. Looks like double-charge of the same usage bucket.

BillingBot (system): Audit trail for INV-2026-0099:
- Charge events: CHG-55011 (2026-05-11 14:03 UTC), CHG-55012 (2026-05-11 14:03 UTC)
- Pricing config change: PRC-EXP-47 applied at 2026-05-11 13:58 UTC (rollout 20%), PRC-EXP-47 reverted at 2026-05-11 14:05 UTC
- Note: duplicate billing entries created during overlap window.

Mark (Finance): For refunds like this we usually issue a customer credit equal to the duplicate line ($5,200) and tag GL-4105 (Billing corrections). If internal chargeback to Product needed, we pass through as internal transfer.

Elena (Sales): Recommend customer-facing full refund/credit for the duplicate $5,200. We'll absorb via product experiment budget. Sparkline is on a strategic upsell path.

Mark (Finance): Approved. Please confirm the exact adjustment amount and provide supporting audit IDs for the ledger note.

Omar (BillingOps): Proposed adjustment command:
```
redwood-bill adjust --cust SP-901 --invoice INV-2026-0099 --amount -5200 --type credit --gl GL-4105 --note "Duplicate charge from pricing experiment PRC-EXP-47 overlap; audit:CHG-55011,CHG-55012"
```

BillingBot (system): Simulation result: Applying -$5,200 credit will produce new invoice total: $7,440. Adjustment ID (sim): ADJ-SIM-334. No dependent discounts will be affected.

Mark (Finance): Run it. Once processed, attach the adjustment ID and updated PDF to internal case FIN-2026-142 and tag @Elena.

Omar (BillingOps): Executing now. Cmd run by billing_ops at 1772058600. Adjustment created: ADJ-33421. Updated invoice: https://console.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0099/adjusted/ADJ-33421.pdf

BillingBot (system): Adjustment ADJ-33421 applied. New invoice balance: $7,440. Journal entry queued under GL-4105. Internal ticket FIN-2026-142 updated.

Zoe (Support): Notified customer: "We've applied a $5,200 credit to correct a duplicate billing line caused by a pricing experiment overlap. Your invoice INV-2026-0099 has been updated. We apologize for the noise and will follow up with details." :white_check_mark:

Elena (Sales): I'll send a short note explaining the experiment timeline and next steps. Also offering a one-time courtesy credit of $250 toward next month.

Mark (Finance): Please add accounting note: "Refund/credit for duplicate charge due to PRC-EXP-47 rollout overlap. Adjustment ADJ-33421. Charge events CHG-55011/CHG-55012. GL-4105." Also file ACCT-7892 for month-end reconciliation.

Omar (BillingOps): Done. Linked ADJ-33421 and CHG logs to FIN-2026-142 and ACCT-7892.

BillingBot (system): Recommendation: Product/Infra to add a guard to prevent applying pricing multipliers twice during overlapping rollouts. Create task PROD-8765.

Elena (Sales): Tagged Product and @Omar to follow up.

Mark (Finance): Closing from finance side after ACCT-7892 posts. Thanks everyone.

Zoe (Support): Customer acknowledged receipt and thanks us for the quick fix. Closing thread. :tada:
